component.name: Scanner Mouse
component.summary: Scan documents and photos with the LG Smart Scan mouse

description.p: Scanner Mouse makes the LG Smart Scan mouse (LSM-100, LSM-150) work as a hand scanner on Linux. Sweep the mouse over a page and watch it appear; the app joins the camera pictures into one page while you scan and corrects it as more of the page comes in.

ul.li: Text pages are straightened, cleaned and recognised with Tesseract
Photos keep their tones and are turned so their edges run straight
Save as PNG, JPEG, searchable PDF or plain text
